milestones.reading: 原开发成绩保留；锁定策略来自人工锚点，归为人工参照。
主轨未过等预算随机搜索对照；突变以根向量为起点，未实现从现任优胜者连续爬山。
跨半选优的地形诊断按原门槛判为“不确定”。
固定的分块重组未通过开发门槛，未启动后续搜索比较。
可观测选择器通过旧板开发门槛，新板对冻结整板赢家的主比较失败。
按预注册止损结束 T5；相对现状的比较保留为描述性证据。
已验收；反例与主结论同页，分别报告固定 P 和事后逐行最优现状。

definitions.C1: V_COST.L minus the comparator.L on the same row; pair signs strictly <0, =0, >0 with no tolerance. Mean is sum(delta)/n.
definitions.posthoc_min: one comparator per row chosen retrospectively by min(P.L,PERIODIC.L,ALARM.L); not a deployable baseline
definitions.missing: absent arm: null statistics, not a tie or zero loss
definitions.references: source#/path/{i} resolves via sources[source].commit and path; expand row_indices using their frozen source order; no new draws

T4b.level: T4b synthetic holdout: registered B comparison, others descriptive readbacks

v3c.level: new synthetic panel: all V_COST contrasts here are descriptive, not the S-W primary outcome

T4d.level: public development, original BASE only; S0/S1/S2 sensitivity panels excluded

C4.new_level: new synthetic confirmation panel; this W reuse is a descriptive readback
C4.tolerance_definition: 0 <= L - certified_min <= 1/100; strictly greater means residual room

operations.pointer_best: mean over conditions of min over named members (L - certified_min), retrospective
operations.single_fixed: min over named members of mean over all conditions (L - certified_min), same member for every condition

C4.excluded_evaluator: ORACLE and auxiliary P are not members

pointer_audit.source: 2026-11-25 user-approved T6 brief, stage 1; reference values are not inputs to fitting or filtering
pointer_audit.seconds_check: 1a: compare at displayed precision; 1b: absolute difference <= 0.01 s; counts and denominators exact

v3a best of fixed candidate set, rowwise
